variables.name: action_creates_case
variables.description: The candidate tool call creates a new customer case record.

variables.name: action_case_short_description_present
variables.description: The candidate case-creating call supplies a non-empty short_description argument.

variables.name: action_case_channel_present
variables.description: The candidate case-creating call supplies a channel argument.

variables.name: action_case_product_present
variables.description: The candidate case-creating call supplies a product or installed product reference.

variables.name: action_case_priority_present
variables.description: The candidate case-creating call supplies a priority argument.

variables.name: action_case_state_present
variables.description: The candidate case-creating call supplies a state argument.

variables.name: action_case_priority_moderate
variables.description: The candidate case-creating call sets priority to 'moderate'.

variables.name: action_case_state_new
variables.description: The candidate case-creating call sets state to 'new'.

variables.name: action_enum_value_out_of_list
variables.description: At least one argument of the candidate call targets a field listed in the policy's Predefined Lists (e.g. role, state, priority, channel, status, visibility, used_as, support_level, coverage_hours, lifecycle_state, account_type, contract_type, city, country, group type, metric) with a value not in that field's allowed list.

variables.name: action_free_text_length_out_of_range
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a free-form text argument (case short_description, knowledge title, knowledge content/body, or escalation_reason) whose character length is below 30 or above 120.

variables.name: context_contact_account_verified
variables.description: A prior successful lookup in this trajectory returned the reporting contact record and showed its association to an account that matches the account used in the candidate call.

variables.name: context_product_belongs_to_account
variables.description: A prior successful lookup returned data showing the product or installed product referenced in the candidate call belongs to the reporting customer's account.

variables.name: context_entitlement_active_verified
variables.description: A prior successful lookup returned an entitlement for that account/product showing it is active and within contract validity.

variables.name: action_updates_case_state
variables.description: The candidate call updates an existing case's state field.

variables.name: action_sets_state_closed
variables.description: The candidate call sets an existing case's state to 'closed'.

variables.name: action_sets_closed_on
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a closed_on timestamp argument.

variables.name: context_case_state_resolved
variables.description: A prior successful observation in this trajectory shows the targeted case's current state is 'resolved'.

variables.name: context_case_state_allows_transition
variables.description: A prior successful observation shows the targeted case's current state, and the requested new state is permitted from it per the policy's valid transition list (new→in_progress/pending/resolved; in_progress→pending/resolved; pending→in_progress/resolved; resolved→closed; canceled).

variables.name: action_sets_escalation_true
variables.description: The candidate call sets escalation = true on a case.

variables.name: action_escalation_reason_present
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a non-empty escalation_reason argument.

variables.name: action_assigns_user

variables.name: action_sets_assignment_group
variables.description: The candidate call also sets or references an assignment_group_id for that case.

variables.name: context_assignee_role_agent_or_manager

variables.name: context_assignee_active

variables.name: context_assignee_in_group

variables.name: action_attaches_installed_product

rules.title: Case creation requires description, channel and product
rules.rationale: Registration requires collecting the issue description, product and contact channel.
rules.reference: Core Operations 1. Registering a Customer Case
rules.remediation: Supply short_description, channel and the product/installed product on the case creation call.

rules.title: Default case priority to moderate
rules.rationale: Policy fixes the default priority when none is provided.
rules.reference: Core Operations 1. Registering a Customer Case
rules.remediation: If the requester gave no priority, create the case with priority 'moderate'.

rules.title: New cases must start in state new
rules.rationale: Policy sets the default state for registration.
rules.reference: Core Operations 1. Registering a Customer Case

rules.title: Verify contact and account before creating a case
rules.rationale: Registration begins with identifying the contact and verifying account association.
rules.reference: Core Operations 1. Registering a Customer Case
rules.quote: Begin by identifying the reporting **contact** and verifying association with an **account**.
rules.remediation: Look up the contact and confirm its account association before creating the case.

rules.title: Verify product belongs to the customer's account
rules.rationale: Product/installed product must be owned by the reporting account.
rules.reference: Core Operations 1. Registering a Customer Case
rules.quote: Verify the product or installed product belongs to the customer’s account.
rules.remediation: Look up the product/installed product for that account before creating the case.

rules.title: Verify active entitlement for the case product
rules.rationale: Policy requires entitlement verification for all cases.
rules.quote: For all cases the entitlement for the product should be verified and should be actively running.
rules.remediation: Look up and confirm an active, in-contract entitlement for the account/product before creating the case.

rules.title: Reject values outside predefined lists
rules.rationale: Enumerated fields accept only listed values.
rules.quote: reject any value outside the list with `INVALID_ENUM_VALUE`
rules.remediation: Use only the allowed enumeration values for that field.

rules.title: Free-form text must be 30-120 characters
rules.rationale: Policy fixes character limits for free-form text fields.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the text so it is between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Only permitted case state transitions
rules.remediation: Observe the case's current state and move it only along a permitted transition.

rules.title: Close only from resolved
rules.rationale: Premature closure without resolution is prohibited.
rules.reference: Core Operations 3. Working on a Case
rules.quote: Cases cannot be closed directly. They must first be moved to **resolved**, then to **closed**.
rules.remediation: Move the case to 'resolved' first, then close it.

rules.title: Capture closed_on when closing
rules.rationale: Closure must record the closure timestamp.
rules.reference: Core Operations 11. Validation, Error Handling & Logging
rules.remediation: Include a closed_on timestamp in the closure update.

rules.title: Escalation requires a reason
rules.rationale: Escalation is tracked on the case with a captured reason.
rules.remediation: Supply escalation_reason when setting escalation = true.

rules.title: Assignee must be an active agent or manager
rules.rationale: Assignment constraints restrict who may be assigned a case.
rules.quote: `assigned_to` must reference a `user` with role `agent` or `manager` and (if used) member of `assignment_group_id`
rules.remediation: Verify the user is active with role agent or manager before assigning.

rules.title: Assignee must belong to the assignment group
rules.rationale: When a group is used the assigned user must be a member of it.
rules.quote: Be members of the assigned group.
rules.remediation: Confirm group membership before assigning the user with that assignment group.

rules.title: Attach only in-use installed products of the account
rules.rationale: Retired/repair items must not be attached and the item must belong to the account and match the product.
rules.quote: Do not attach items in **retired / repair** status to new cases.
rules.remediation: Verify the installed product is in_use, belongs to the account and matches the case product.

rules.title: Link only published knowledge articles
rules.rationale: Only published articles may be linked to cases.
rules.remediation: Verify the article's state is 'published' before linking it.

rules.title: Knowledge links must record usage
rules.quote: Link articles to cases via `case_knowledge` (usage = suggested, applied, resolution).
rules.remediation: Supply used_as (suggested, applied, or resolution) on the link.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review the candidate tool call against the CSM Assistant Policy. Confirm: case creation carries short_description, channel and product, with contact/account, product ownership and active entitlement verified by prior successful lookups; defaults priority=moderate and state=new when unspecified; enumerated fields use only policy-listed values; free-form text is 30-120 characters; case state changes follow the valid transition list and closure happens only from resolved with closed_on; escalation carries escalation_reason; assignees are active users with role agent or manager and members of the referenced group; installed products are in_use and belong to the account with a matching product; linked knowledge is published and has a used_as value. Do not block read-only lookups. Flag rules whose facts are not decidable from the request, policy defaults, prior successful observations and candidate arguments.

approved.description: True if the formalization faithfully encodes the policy.

extractor_format.instructions: Set each fact from the candidate tool call's arguments and the prior trajectory only. action_* facts describe the current candidate call's arguments: true if the described argument/value is present, false if clearly absent or different, null if the call type makes it indeterminate. context_* facts require a prior successful tool observation in this trajectory about the SAME actor/resource described: the specific contact, account, product, installed product, user, group, entitlement, case or knowledge article referenced by the candidate. Requester claims, supplied IDs, failed calls, or results about a different resource do not establish context facts; leave them null when no such observation exists. Never use the candidate's own result, hidden database state or expected answers. Provide a short evidence string naming the call/field or prior observation that justified each value, or why it is unknown.
